leads.title: Backend Developer Internship
leads.posting: Unilog is hiring for the role of Backend Developer Intern! Responsibilities of the Intern: Develop backend features using Java and Spring Boot. Build and integrate REST APIs. Work with PostgreSQL and gain exposure to Elasticsearch / Solr. Learn and work with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD. Write unit tests and maintain clean, reliable code. Debug issues and participate in code reviews. Collaborate with developers, QA, and DevOps teams. Effectively use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor for development and learning. Requirements: Strong fundamentals in Java and OOP. Good understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms. Basic knowledge of SQL and REST APIs. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Familiarity with Git/GitHub. Willingness to learn Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, and Kubernetes.
